name: coq-harness-video
description: Motion-graphics presentation of coq-harness, rendered with Remotion

scripts.render: remotion render Presentation out/raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/coq-harness.mp4 && rm out/raw.mp4
scripts.render:nosubs: remotion render Presentation out/raw-nosubs.mp4 --props='{"subtitles":false}' && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/raw-nosubs.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/coq-harness-nosubs.mp4 && rm out/raw-nosubs.mp4
